comingLast.roast: level with Leywood at the wrong end - the tension is real and hilarious
at 1.3 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
at 1.1 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
6 to play and the blue balls are already doing warm-down stretches
on 17 with 5 to play - Smythe is quietly cheering against him
on 22 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
still swinging on 19 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
on 24 - the only man on the course playing match play against the bottom of the list
level with Smythe at the bottom - the blue balls may need a countback
safe by 1 unless the course gets generous late
